articles.title: AMD rides data center riches to ‘largest and most profitable’ quarter in history
articles.essence: AMD CEO Lisa Su said in the company's quarterly earnings call on Tuesday that Q3 2026 was "was the largest and most profitable in our history." articles.title: The biggest modding site in PC gaming is taking a stance on AI
articles.essence: The PC gaming mods repository Nexus Mods is making disclosures about AI mandatory for uploads of new mods, meaning that mod authors will have to declare "whether AI has been used in their work," the site announced today as part of a big post about AI-generated content on the platform. articles.title: Please stop asking me when the AI bubble will pop
